about_the_game:
Note:
This game is made by just me, Cody, and any feedback you have is welcome.

This demo includes the first fully playable level of six.


Do what brings you happiness. This is a game about life, about living, and about home.

Part game, part personal art piece, Time in Place is a cozy, interactive fiction where you experience life through 6 distinct stages of adulthood, all within the walls of an evolving apartment. Detailed, immersive interactions and sounds combine with a colorful, singular art style to create a rich world you can feel at home in.

Each of the six levels is an endless morning from a unique period of the character's life. A sunny day in the late 90s, a good time to put on the radio and work on your writing assignments. Or a rainy weekend morning years later, perfect for playing 64-bit console games or recording a synth track. You are free to explore and live in each level as long as you wish and only progress when you choose to. Return anytime to enjoy each stage's unique interactable objects, activities, and vibes.

An ambient narrative is told through the objects and spaces unique to each level. That means it is up to you to decide how much you want to learn. Dig through drawers, and piece together notes on scrap paper to discover back stories and romances. Or let the space and objects communicate the vibe. As you play, the character's passions, ambitions, failures, and joys fill the ever evolving apartment.

  • Create and Express Yourself: Play in game synthesizers, guitars, and drum machines. Record it all on a retro 4-track cassette recorder and export to mp3. Add your own ending to a short story or poem.

  • Tangible Nostalgia: Find and listen to multiple vinyl records, take photos on an instant camera, and play with toy trains and car.

  • Morning Rituals: Each level has its own unique coffee brewing technique to master, messes to clean, or relaxing activities to enjoy.

  • Games within Games: Load up floppy disks, pop in cartridges, and click on icons! Each level contains multiple time period specific mini games, from text adventure to freely skiing, to 64-bit console favorites. 

  • A lush audio world that shines when you INTERACT, and ambient sounds from the street or courtyard bring the cozy world to life.

  • PLAY a beautifully sampled piano, synthesizer, drum machine, or guitar. EXPERIMENT with guitar pedals, or your own voice (USB/console mic).

  • RECORD your own 4 track songs, mix them, and save to an mp3 to share.

name: Time in Place Demo
short_description: Time in Place is an interactive fiction, set in the same cozy apartment, over 6 different life stages. Play music instruments, make coffee, and work on your novel. No timers, no pressing needs, just relaxing mornings to explore, experience, and exist in while you unravel the story, or relax.
supported_languages: English, German, Danish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese
